DrugNameSelector.description: One explicit ChEMBL name filter without fallback or synonym expansion.
x-enum-descriptions: Match the native preferred name exactly, ignoring case.
Match an explicit native synonym exactly, ignoring case.

DrugRecallClassification.description: FDA's native recall classification, with no local ranking.

PartialDate.description: A Gregorian date preserving year, month or day precision. The parser additionally validates the calendar day, including leap years.

Text.description: Bounded nonempty text with surrounding Unicode whitespace removed.

description: Search one drug source. FDA drug recalls accept a name or native firm, classification, status, reason and initiation dates; counts are recall records. WHO prequalification accepts a name or date range. Other sources require a name.

classification.description: Native FDA classification; drug recalls only.

firm.description: Literal published recalling firm phrase; drug recalls only.

initiated_from.description: Inclusive initiation day, YYYY-MM-DD; drug recalls only.

initiated_to.description: Inclusive initiation day, YYYY-MM-DD; drug recalls only.

name_selector.description: Explicit ChEMBL native name selector; omitted means preferred name.

prequalified_from.description: Inclusive WHO prequalification lower bound, YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD; WHO PQ only.

prequalified_to.description: Inclusive WHO prequalification upper bound, YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD; WHO PQ only.

query.description:
Search phrase; optional for FDA drug recalls and WHO date ranges. Drugs@FDA searches brands and ingredients,
exact names before word matches. openFDA labels search exact then word brand/generic names,
then label text (including indications) when no names match; source matches need not be exact names.
Harmonized recall names match but never become display names.

reason.description: Phrase in the published recall reason; drug recalls only.

source.description: Exactly one source; default MyChem never fans out.

status.description: Literal native recall status; drug recalls only.

title: DrugSearch
